summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Indian PII Redaction Tool. All core features working correctly: single file upload (.docx), batch multi-file upload, .doc legacy file support, download functionality, audit CSV export, and UI reset functionality. Backend API returning proper audit_log structure.

Legacy .doc file redaction (4 PII items detected)
Batch processing simulation (28 total PII items across 2 files)
Audit log structure validation (proper category, placeholder, location fields)
File type validation (rejects invalid formats with 400)
File size limit enforcement (rejects >10MB files with 400)
Single file upload UI flow (upload → processing → results)
Batch file upload UI flow (multiple files → combined stats)
Per-file results display for batch uploads
Individual file download buttons for batch results
Start Over button resets to upload state
File input accepts .doc and .docx formats with multiple attribute

Toast notifications showing correct file counts
.doc file conversion to .docx format in backend
